report_name: Forescout Research: AI Finds 66 New TCP/IP Stack Flaws in 90 Hours

tools.name: Commercial AI Models
tools.description: Commercial AI models, such as those from Anthropic, were used in a research pipeline to perform automated static analysis on TCP/IP stack source code, accelerating vulnerability discovery by 20x.

vulnerabilities.name: Multiple TCP/IP Stack Vulnerabilities
vulnerabilities.description: A set of 99 vulnerabilities, including 66 zero-days, discovered in 10 common TCP/IP stacks using AI-assisted analysis. The flaws include high and critical severity issues such as buffer overflows, integer overflows, and improper input validation, affecting OT, IoT, and medical devices. 52% of the new bugs were rated as high or critical.

identities.name: Forescout
identities.description: Cybersecurity vendor whose research lab, Vedere Labs, published the research on AI-assisted vulnerability discovery.

identities.name: Vedere Labs
identities.description: The research arm of Forescout that conducted the study demonstrating that AI can accelerate vulnerability discovery in TCP/IP stacks.

identities.name: Anthropic
identities.description: AI company whose commercial models were used by Forescout researchers to analyze TCP/IP stack source code for vulnerabilities.
